$provenance.target: Local conformance HQ from the recorded source, with disposable PostgreSQL, fake Zerops, fake GitHub
steps: Use Node 24.19.0 and follow conformance/README.md for PostgreSQL, Git, Go and object-store prerequisites; run vp install in conformance/.
From conformance/ set recordings_dir to a new empty temporary directory outside the checkout.
From conformance/ run TMPDIR=/private/tmp GOTOOLCHAIN=local HQ_RECORD_EXEMPLARS="$recordings_dir" env -u HQ_COMMAND vp test run s10a-github-app.test.ts.
The whole GitHub case file runs so its fake app and installation IDs have the same preceding-case sequence.
Compare the generated org-github.needs-owner-seal.json value with this recording. Remove the temporary directory; the harness stops its local processes and fixtures.
$provenance.command: cd conformance && TMPDIR=/private/tmp GOTOOLCHAIN=local HQ_RECORD_EXEMPLARS=<empty-output-dir> env -u HQ_COMMAND vp test run s10a-github-app.test.ts
